title: The Spark of the Web
narrative: 1990 was the year the digital universe expanded beyond military and academic networks. Tim Berners-Lee's proposal at CERN planted the seed of the World Wide Web, while IRC and BBS culture proved that humans craved digital connection.

felt_like.music: Napster was years away—cassette tapes and CDs
